items.name: Burrito plate
items.description: A substantial burrito plate on the waterfront patio, with flume-splash seating included.
items.verdict: The best lunch at the park — eat it flume-side and let the soak show do the entertaining.

items.name: Soft serve swirl
items.description: Cold swirl in a cup from the ride-cluster cart — the between-launch cooldown.
items.verdict: Exactly what a soft-serve cart should be: fast, cold, correctly placed. Timing is everything — before the eel, not after.

items.name: Churro
items.description: Cinnamon churro from the waterfront carts, eaten walking the bay side.
items.verdict: The reliable walking snack in the park's best walking section.
